evidence: Wallet label and modifications concentrated in src/wallet/scan.cpp and related wallet headers to parallelize compact filter evaluation.
rationale: Parallelizing BIP 157/158 compact block filter evaluation yields a substantial 4.5x to nearly 8x speedup during fast wallet rescans. Benchmark evidence across 200,000 blocks demonstrated a drop from 272 seconds to 35 seconds on 8 threads, tackling the explicitly recognized wallet priority of slow rescans.
